params.prompt: Graphic novel inked illustration, painted tableau, a frozen moment. An old grey-bearded man kneels beside a softly glowing pool of water at the edge of a desert camp, looking up into the dark sky; a small group of desert-robed figures stand at a distance near tents. The camera performs a slow, reverent push-in toward the kneeling man's face and the glowing water. Nothing moves -- the man's pose, the distant figures, and the light stay fixed as drawn. No invented motion, no morphing, no new elements, no camera shake. Painted tableau stays still; only the camera moves.
